source_text: Sicut malum inter ligna silvarum, sic dilectus meus inter filios. Sub umbra illius quem desideraveram sedi, et fructus eius dulcis gutturi meo. Malum Christus, ligna silvae ceteri homines. Umbra eius protectio; fructus doctrina et immortalitas.
pass_a_gloss: As apple-tree among woods of-forests, so beloved my among sons. Under shadow of-him whom I-had-desired I-sat, and fruit of-him sweet to-throat my...
pass_b_english: [[As an apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among the sons. Under his shadow whom I desired I sat, and his fruit was sweet to my throat >> Bible:Song of Songs 2:3]]. The apple tree is Christ; the trees of the wood are other humans. His shadow is protection; his fruit teaching and immortality.
